historical_mixer.scope: Oct14 isolated real native mixer on pre-main source; not the combined packaged runtime or physical listening.

pcm.method: Music: fixed 2s source excerpt after a 400Hz high-pass; accepted only with gain consistent with 0.045, match time compatible with selection, and correlation margin >=0.25 over reversed-source and unused-garage controls. Equal-gain time-offset mix + engine/noise calibration verifies this margin. Feedback: unchanged raw mono12kHz comparison, reported separately without a mixed-signal pass threshold.

historical_mixer.feedback_scope: Feedback correlation retained separately in original report, not reinterpreted as a music threshold pass.
